back: Authorities provide plots with roads, water and sewers; families build their own houses.
A town built away from a large city to relieve pressure on it; a dormitory town if most residents commute to the city.
Protected open land around a city where building is restricted to stop sprawl.
A city meeting present needs without harming the environment or future residents: public transport, renewables, recycling, green space.
Who benefits? Cost and maintenance? Scale? Sustainability? Community participation?
Rural service centres (e.g. Gokwe, Murambinda) developed since the 1980s to reduce migration to big cities.
Bus rapid transit with dedicated lanes, parks on flood-prone land, recycling and a 'green exchange' scheme.
Site-and-service schemes, upgrading in Epworth, satellite towns (Chitungwiza, Norton, Ruwa), bus and kombi regulation, water works rehabilitation.
High-capacity buses in dedicated lanes with raised stations for fast boarding.
